Title: [JOURNEY] Customer Members Plant a Tagged Search and Product View, the Plain Rep Reads Them Under Exactly That Organization on Every Activity Surface and Opens the Term in a New Tab
Section: Sales Rep > Customer Activity > [JOURNEY] > Plant and read back
Preconditions: Env vcptcore-qa, store {{STORE_ID}} (B2B-store), SalesRep + GoogleEcommerceAnalytics modules installed, theme delivers the hub from the sales-rep plugin. SR_REP_PRIMARY is a PLAIN rep (never an administrator - admins pass every scope check) and serves @td(ORG_ACME.id), @td(ORG_TECHFLOW.id), @td(ORG_BUILDRIGHT.id) and others. Tracked (GA) figures appear 24-48 h after the event, hour-bucketed, cached 60 min per date range per replica {SPEC} (VCST-5337 2026-10-02). TWO-PHASE JOURNEY, because GA lag makes plant and read-back impossible in one sitting. PHASE 1 (plant) runs on every execution and leaves tomorrow's batch; PHASE 2 (read back) reads the NEWEST earlier batch that is at least 24 h old. Token shape (random-data, AGENT-TEST- prefix so teardown sweeps it): AGENT-TEST-qa5337act-<member>-<yyyymmdd>-<rand4>; the date and random part are recorded as PLANT_DATE / PLANT_RAND in the run results (never hardcoded, never written to a file path). Members are the three ACME members with an organization on this env (@td(ACME_ADMIN.email) maintainer, @td(ACME_BUYER.email) purchasing agent, @td(ACME_BUYER2.email) purchasing agent). READ-BACK GATE: if no earlier batch (token prefix AGENT-TEST-qa5337act- dated at least 24 h before now) exists in the rep's All time Searches, end the case BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET after PHASE 1 (first-ever run: plant only). If the newest earlier batch is 24-48 h old and its rows are missing, end BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET (lag not elapsed); only a batch older than 48 h + 60 min cache TTL with missing rows is a FAIL. Never FAIL on a batch that GA may not have processed yet.
